segments.speaker: celandine_marrowby
segments.text: How dreadful. Someone will have to decide what to do with them. Not me, I hope.

segments.speaker: celandine_marrowby
segments.text: Clever. You've been listening to me. Very well, my stores for the little ones. Lent at interest, naturally.

segments.speaker: celandine_marrowby
segments.text: Well. That does rather change the interest.

segments.speaker: bree_tallow
segments.text: Found them under the bridge, behind the pilings. Too weak to run with the rest. Neither of them's bigger than Pip, Halden.

segments.speaker: bree_tallow
segments.text: She bit me twice on the way here. I'd call that healthy.

segments.speaker: bree_tallow
segments.text: I'll take the little ones home tonight. Pip can teach them to steal bread properly.
